storylines.text: Munetaka Murakami is in a real home run drought — none in his last 10 games — but the underlying indicators haven't cooled the same way: a .248 ISO and a 0.891 OPS this season say the power is still there, it just hasn't landed yet. HOU sends out Ronel Blanco today, in a park that plays up for power.

James Wood is running hot right now, hitting well above his 0.259 season average over his last games with at least one home run in that stretch. He faces AZ sends out Kohl Drake today, in a pitcher-friendly park, a pitcher who's allowed a 0.222 average against this season.
